Definition: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
BiblicalUsage: 1) to forget, ignore, wither; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to forget; 1a2) to cease to care; 1b) (Niphal) to be forgotten; 1c) (Piel) to cause to forget; 1d) (Hiphil) to make or cause to forget; 1e) (Hithpael) to be forgotten
